Chapter 1: Subscription Data 2 Section A: Access Service - An Overview 1.1 The number of telephone subscribers in India increased from 1,200.80 million at the end of Mar-25 to 1,218.36 million at the end of Jun-25, registering a rate of growth 1.46% over the previous quarter. This reflects year-on-year (Y-O-Y) rate of growth 1.06% over the same quarter of last year. The overall Tele-density in India increased from 85.04% as on 31st March, 2025 to 86.09% as on 30th June, 2025 with quarterly rate of growth 1.24%.
